title: HYROX training in Newquay
seo_description: Train for HYROX in Newquay at Hybrid Hub, a HYROX affiliated gym at Prow Park. Coached HYROX classes, a run club and a 24 hour open gym.
intro: Coached HYROX classes, a run club and a 24 hour open gym at Prow Park. Whether it's your first race or you're chasing a podium, train for it here.
image_alt: The class zone at Hybrid Hub
blocks_intro: A fitness race for everyone: 8 × 1 km runs, each followed by a workout station. The format is the same at every race around the world, so you can measure your progress.

blocks.title: 8 × 1 km runs
blocks.text: Half of the race is running, so a strong engine matters as much as strength.

blocks.title: 8 stations
blocks.text: SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls.

blocks.title: Race your way
blocks.text: Race on your own, with a partner in Doubles, or as a relay team of four.

sections.title: How we train for it
paragraphs: Our HYROX classes combine running with HYROX stations to build the fitness and pacing you need for race day.
HYROX Two Gen is a shorter 30-minute session, and Run Club is a 45-minute group run. Between classes, the open gym is yours 24 hours a day.

people_intro: Our coaches race HYROX too. Learn from people who know what race day takes.

faqs.question: Do I need to be fit to start HYROX training?
faqs.answer: No. Every class is coached, so you can work at your own level. If you're new to training, our START small groups are a good first step.

faqs.question: Can I train for my first HYROX race here?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our HYROX classes build the running, the station work and the pacing you need for your first race.

faqs.question: Which membership do I need?
faqs.answer: Full membership includes unlimited coached classes, and Hybrid 2X includes 2 classes a week. See the Memberships page for every option.

faqs.question: I'm visiting Newquay. Can I train with you?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book a drop-in session, leave your details and we'll call you to book you in.

closing_text: Apply to join and we'll be in touch to get you started.
